title: Prepositions
info: A preposition shows a relationship, often of place or time.
In, on, under, beside, before, and after are prepositions.
In 'The book is on the desk', on links book to desk.

questions.q: In 'The cat is under the chair', under tells

options: The bag is beside the door.

questions.q: On, in, and at can all
options: Show a relationship of place or time
